subject.title: fix: embedded_run completes with empty final payload → reply silently dropped (lane goes dark

question: Should OpenClaw intentionally reclassify delivery-requested empty isolated cron completions from ok/no-delivery results into cron errors by default?
rationale: The code path is narrow and matches the linked report, but it changes an observable shipped cron completion state for existing operators.

options.title: Prove and accept fail-closed cron errors
options.body: Require redacted real cron logs or a live validation transcript, then land the error reclassification if the owner accepts the compatibility change.

options.title: Require a compatibility-preserving shape
options.body: Ask for an approved opt-in policy or diagnostic path if existing empty cron completions should not become errors by default.

options.title: Pause for broader runner policy
options.body: Hold the PR if maintainers want genuinely empty completions handled by a wider supervisor or retry policy instead of cron finalization.

recommendation.title: Prove and accept fail-closed cron errors
recommendation.body: Require redacted real cron logs or a live validation transcript, then land the error reclassification if the owner accepts the compatibility change.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on the cron finalization and delivery policy boundary touched by this PR.
